title: SnapShop
description: A lightweight, fast, and GUI-based player-to-player barter market plugin.
body:
## ⚡ SnapShop — Quick & Secure P2P Barter Market

**SnapShop** is a lightweight, high-performance, and completely GUI-based player-to-player (P2P) barter marketplace plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. Allow your players to trade items safely without the need for complex economy or vault systems—just pure, vanilla-friendly item-for-item trading!

### ✨ Key Features

* **100% GUI-Driven:** Browse shops, list items, and claim rewards entirely inside clean chest menus.
* **Player Head Icons:** The main market displays custom heads of players who currently have active listings.
* **Advanced Anti-Dupe Security:** Hardened against shift-clicking exploits, hotbar swapping, and inventory race conditions.
* **Offline Support:** Items can be bought even if the seller is offline. Earnings are safely stored in their virtual deposit box.
* **Smart Chat Parsing:** List items easily by typing what you want in return (e.g., typing `grass 64 ve stone 32`).

---

### 🛠️ Commands & Permissions (Komutlar)

| Command | Description | Türkçe Açıklaması |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/snapshop language` | The language can be changed with this command. | **Dil değiştirme komutu.** |
| `/shop` | Opens the main global market GUI. | **Ana menüyü açar.** |
| `/shop sell` | Starts the process to list an item for sale. | **Eşya satmanızı sağlar.** |
| `/shop claim` | Opens the storage GUI to claim your earnings. | **Kazandığınız eşyaları alır.** |

> 💡 *Not: Türkçe Komutlar `/pazar`, `/pazar sat`, ve `/shop claim` Şeklindedir.*

---

### 🛡️ Compatibility

* **Supported Platforms:** Paper and Purpur.
* **Supported Versions:** Minecraft 26.1.2
* **Requires:** Java 21 or higher.
